body:
## Anomaly Re-Scan — Sep 15 23:40 UTC (18:40 CDT)

Third scheduled scan. **All 4 anomalies remain unpatched. No new anomaly types.** One new finding below.

### New Finding: Scanner stall (~19 hours)

The last record in the log file is `ts=2026-09-15T04:57:51Z`, block `#93,828,825`. As of this scan (23:40 UTC), **no new scan output has been produced in ~19 hours**. The automated scanner may have stopped or is not logging. This extends anomaly #4 (inactivity gaps) from missing daily files to a full stall.

### Updated Evidence

| # | Anomaly | Status | Evidence |
|---|---------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Round-trip profitability bug | UNPATCHED | Sep 15 rec 8: WMATIC→USDC 20K flagged EXECUTE ($61.68 net). Live round-trip verified: -$99.55 actual loss. Negative at ALL sizes 200–20K. |
| 2 | Phantom guard nondeterminism | UNPATCHED | **New evidence**: WMATIC→USDC 50K at ~8.3% spread → EXECUTE on Sep 14 (rec 4), PHANTOM on Sep 15 (rec 9). Same pair, same size, nearly identical spread → opposite verdict. |
| 3 | isPhantom/phantom fields always false | UNPATCHED | 5/11 records have `👻 PHANTOM` signal label but `phantom: false` and `isPhantom: false` in the structured fields. |
| 4 | Scanner inactivity gaps | UNPATCHED | Sep 5, 10, 13, 15 missing as daily files. Sep 15 data appended to Sep 14 file. **No new output in ~19h.** |

### Clear Items
- No DAI phantom spreads (zero DAI pairs)
- No zero-liquidity pairs flagged as EXECUTE (all pairs have >$15K on at least one DEX side)
- No stale oracle signals detected in available data

### Recommendations
1. **Halt any automated execution** until the round-trip profitability bug (#1) is patched
2. Patch the phantom guard to set structured `phantom`/`isPhantom` fields correctly (#3)
3. Investigate why the scanner is not producing new output — cron job may need restart (#4)
4. Replace one-way quote comparison with actual round-trip `getAmountsOut` validation (#1)
